S6b-1: no Save, Reload, Preview or Apply row; first run writes nothing on open
S6b-1: adding a rule and leaving the field saves exactly that list, other settings unchanged, and it survives a restart
S6b-1: a blank new row writes nothing; deleting the last rule saves an empty list
S6b-1: exact-path entries keep their id, scope and bytes across glob saves
S6b-2: adding a rule asks in place, without taking focus; nothing is removed without the answer; Keep them keeps files
S6b-2 B4: Remove from search applies the saved rules and says it in plain words, including what was not checked
B4: a partial removal names what was not checked in plain words and offers Try again
B4: a bare success receipt is never shown as a complete removal
S6b-7: with the Worker down a skip rule still saves through the Head and removal says it cannot run now
B2: when the saved list changes while the ask is open, the ask is withdrawn and asked again for the new list
B2: one ask at a time across several added rules
S6b-3: a half pattern is never saved or applied; the reason shows; fixing it saves
S6b-3: a legacy saved literal-name rule does not block saving other edits
S6b-4: typing during an in-flight save keeps the field usable, never shows later text as saved, then saves it too
S6b-4: while text is unsaved after an in-flight save it is not called saved
B3: an unknown outcome says Not sure this saved, keeps the same key and bytes, and reconciles before a newer draft
B3: leaving Library or switching tabs leaves the field and saves
B3: a load failure says so with Try again, and the editor is not editable until loaded
S6b-5: another window changed the rules: draft kept, Changed elsewhere offers both choices, no silent overwrite
S6b-5: Use the saved rules takes the other window's list and writes nothing
S6b-5: an unrelated save elsewhere does not raise a conflict or lose the draft
512-entry capacity refusal keeps the draft and the saved rules, in plain words
S6b-6: the battery rule saves on change, first change keeps a null schedule, carrying the revision it was based on
S6b-6: hours save on change; an invalid combination is not sent and says why; turning hours off keeps days and times
B6: hours changed in another window: draft kept, Changed elsewhere, Keep my draft writes on the shown revision; Use the saved rules writes nothing
B6: an unrelated save elsewhere does not stop a reading-hours change
overlap: skip-rule save, hours save and toolbar pause/resume never leave a stale witness or lose a draft
S6b-9 B5: Undo is offered for the last glob change only, restores the rule list only and keeps hidden settings
B5: the Undo detail says removed files come back when read again
B5: no Undo once another settings save happened since, for an earlier glob change, or for exact-path removal
B4: per-rule Preview counts are behind developer tools only
S6b-12: an override keeps the editor editable and saved, explains when it takes effect, and asks nothing
R6: removal is bound to the list asked about; a list saved elsewhere after the check removes nothing and is asked again
R7: the bytes saved are the draft captured when the field was left, never text typed after returning to it
R7: a re-send after an unrelated save elsewhere sends the captured draft, not text typed meanwhile
R8: a reading-rule write whose answer is lost says Not sure this saved, and is settled with the same key and bytes before a newer change
R8: Try again settles an uncertain reading-rule write by its key without sending anything newer
R9: a reading-rule change queued behind a pending save is still saved after leaving Library
R10: removal words never turn deletion-request counts into a number of files
R11 (review 1): a change queued behind a write whose answer is lost survives leaving and returning, and is saved after that write is settled
R11 (review 2): a newer skip-rule draft left while an uncertain write waits is saved after that write is rebased across an unrelated save
R11 (review 2): when the uncertain write's list is found saved, the newer draft is still saved after it
R11 (review 3): a reading-hours change is saved as it was when its field was left, not as typed after returning to it
R12 (review 4): an older removal result keeps the newer ask and names only the list it removed for
R11: an unknown outcome, then leaving and returning, keeps the newer draft shown as not saved yet until the write is settled
R11: two queued snapshots of each editor are saved in order across an unrelated revision move
R11: Undo pressed behind a write whose outcome is unknown settles that write first and never overwrites it
R11: a draft left behind an Undo whose answer was lost is saved after that Undo is settled
R13 (review 5): text typed while an Undo is pending stays when the Undo completes and is saved when its field is left
R13 (review 5): an Undo completing for an unchanged draft still shows the list it restored
R14 (review 5): a replay reporting RUNNING without a witness is not saved; the write is followed until it fails
R14 (review 5): a newer reading-rule change waits while a RUNNING write is followed, then is saved after it settles
R17 (review 6): a read begun before a save completed never replaces the saved rules or their revision
R18 (review 6): a stalled follow-up is abandoned at the bound: Not sure this saved, same key kept, other writes go on, a late answer settles nothing
R18 (review 6): a follow-up held in admission retries is abandoned at the bound as well
R19 (review 6): Try again after a partial removal and a rule removed since asks for the list saved now
R19 (review 6): Try again for a list changed since keeps a newer ask open and does not run
R19 (review 6): Try again with no skip rules left says there is nothing to remove
R20 (acceptor): Count matching files is unavailable while a removal runs and starts nothing
R22 (review 7): a stalled first reading-rule send ends at the bound: Not sure this saved, same key kept, chain freed, a late answer settles nothing
R22 (review 7): RUNNING, then VERSION_CONFLICT, then a stalled re-read ends at the bound for reading rules; the late read changes nothing
R22 (review 7): RUNNING, then VERSION_CONFLICT, then a stalled re-read ends at one bound per skip-rule write
R19 (review 6): Try again on a removal outcome while an override is now in effect says why nothing runs
R23 (review 8): an unanswered toolbar Pause, then a reading-hours change and a skip-rule leave: every owner ends at its bound, leaving and returning keeps nothing blocked
R23 (review 8): an unanswered skip-rule write holds the chain; a reading-hours change and a toolbar Pause behind it end within their own bounds
